brief:
X suspended the campaign account of a Palestinian American candidate running for a U.S. Senate seat representing Pennsylvania in 2028, Middle East Eye reported. The social media platform did not immediately provide a public explanation for the suspension.

The candidate had launched his bid for the Senate seat when the account was suspended. Details about the reasons for X's action remain unclear.
dek: X suspends campaign account of Palestinian American running for US Senate A Palestinian American who launched his bid for a Senate seat to represent Pennsylvania in the 2028 election has had his campaign account suspended by the social media platform X.
title: X suspends Palestinian American's 2028 Senate campaign account
